summary: Practise crisis prioritization, coordination, access decisions and handovers. Explore this five-day humanitarian crisis management training.
lede: Humanitarian crisis management helps emergency coordinators, programme managers and response leads turn changing information into operational decisions. This practical training develops skills to prioritize needs, maintain decision logs with owners and escalation triggers, map coordination routes, assess access options, and prepare an after-action review and response handover using the Humanitarian Programme Cycle and IASC Cluster Approach.
audienceIntro: This intermediate course is designed for people who make or support operational decisions during humanitarian emergencies. It suits roles that coordinate response teams, manage field information, resolve access constraints, or brief senior decision-makers.
prerequisites: Prior experience in humanitarian response, emergency operations, programme delivery, or crisis coordination is recommended. Coding or programming is not required.
